info.name: Wan Video
info.description: Local text/image-to-video with Wan 2.2 TI2V-5B on Apple Silicon (mlx-gen). Start `wan-api` first. Generation runs as jobs: Generate returns a job_id, then poll Get job.

request.description: Whether the package is downloaded, the model is loaded, and how many jobs are active.

exec: const b = pm.response.json(); if (b.job_id) pm.collectionVariables.set('jobId', b.job_id);

body.raw:
{
  "prompt": "A paper boat drifts down a rain-filled gutter, low tracking shot, soft overcast light",
  "width": 832,
  "height": 480,
  "duration_s": 4,
  "steps": 25,
  "seed": 42,
  "output_name": "boat"
}

request.description: Returns 202 with a job_id (stored in {{jobId}}). A clip takes about 12 minutes.

exec: const b = pm.response.json(); if (b.job_id) pm.collectionVariables.set('jobId', b.job_id);

formdata.value: she turns toward the window and smiles, soft morning light

exec: const b = pm.response.json(); if (b.result && b.result.name) pm.collectionVariables.set('videoName', b.result.name);

request.description: Status, progress (phase, step/total_steps) and, when done, the result. Stores the file name in {{videoName}}.
